about: Graphics drivers the player does not render on with the GPU. Built into the host (playback/render_denylist.rs); a file of the same shape at <app data>/render-denylist.json adds rules or replaces them by id ({"id": ..., "disabled": true} switches one off). Fields follow Chromium's software_rendering_list.json: os {type, build}, vendor_id, device_id, driver_version {op, value, value2}, exceptions; action cpu (software rendering), software-windows (the player does not draw its windows with the rule's window_api: opengl, the default, matched against every adapter with a GPU, or direct3d12, matched against the adapter GPU rendering uses; the next window renderer takes over, Direct3D 12 → OpenGL → Slint's software renderer, and GPU rendering is off where it needs those windows) or warn (a note only). Versions compare part by part as numbers; op is <, <=, =, >=, > or between (both ends included).

rules.description: AMD Radeon 780M driver 31.0.14005: GPU draws stall for tens of milliseconds (p95 52 ms) and 4K60 video drops to about 40 fps
refs: Measured on the Windows test machine, 2026-10-27/28, machine idle: offscreen draws on the 780M p50 3.9 ms, p95 52.1 ms, p99 63.0 ms; the RTX 4070 drew the same frames at p95 1.8 ms with identical pixels

rules.description: AMD Radeon 780M driver 32.0.32015.7029 (Adrenalin 26.10.1) and later: OpenGL (femtovg) windows show only white, plugin windows too, while the frame log counts 60 presented frames per second; Slint's software renderer draws them correctly
refs: Seen on the Windows test machine after the 2026-10-28 driver update
